potato~nutrients.q: FARMER ASKING QUERY REGARDING FERTILIZER DOSE OF POTATO.
potato~nutrients.a: SEED RATE-4 Q/BIGHA SEED TREATMENT: IN CASE OF CUT SEEDS, THE PIECES ARE TO BE DIPPED IN MANCOZEB (INDOFIL M-45) @ 5G IN 1 LIT OF WATER FOR ABOUT 10 MINUTES.
